notes: This contract records provider- and FOM-independent API checks for the official IEEE 1516.1 exception hierarchy. The C++ test verifies imported derived-exception construction, name/message accessors, copy/assignment, polymorphism, and stream output. The Java test verifies the 100 same-named standard derived exceptions exposed in the official Java API JAR through RTIexception, name(), and getMessage(). Java copy/assignment and stream behavior are not part of the parity claim, nor are C++ exception types without direct Java counterparts. These are API contract checks only and do not claim provider behavior or cross-RTI interoperability.

api_surfaces.signature: Exception-derived constructors, Exception::name, Exception::what, and stream insertion

api_surfaces.source: adapter-supplied official IEEE 1516.1-2025 Java API JAR
api_surfaces.source_symbol: hla.rti1516_2025.exceptions.RTIexception and common derived exception classes
